cc:Work.dc:description: Prefill processes a three-token prompt and predicts y1 with three cached positions; subsequent passes process y1 then y2, append their KV, and predict y2 then y3.

g.text: Prefill → decode: when does a token enter the KV cache?
[To be reviewed] Ordinary single-token causal generation; three-token prompt, one sequence, layerwise state.
Store K/V for the tokens just processed
Feed sampled y1 into the next forward pass
Store K/V for the tokens just processed
Feed sampled y2 into the next forward pass
Store K/V for the tokens just processed
Continue unless EOS / stopping rule ends generation.
After sampling y1, the cache still contains only x0–x2. y1 gets K/V when the next pass processes y1.
Each layer owns its own cache. Earlier causal K/V are reused; old queries are not needed for future attention.
